81588.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $80,086 (-1.4%) | **ETH** $2,323 (-1.5%) | **SOL** $100 (-2.2%)

* FOMC decision keeps [rates steady](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2115504205696041352?a=_0VHH2te0Fcq9ps4pio&s=20) — Fed Chair Kevin Warsh says the Fed will [skip rate votes](https://x.com/Kalshi/status/2115737909378626003) at one meeting in 2027 and two in 2028

* PCE inflation comes in [at expectations](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2115783910143791414?a=KR0QC-a26v05gh4t6C8&s=20) at 3.6%

* DTCC's Tokenization Service goes live, tokenizing [34 securities](https://www.chooserich.live/story/dtcc-launches-tokenization-service-g5k6huc)

* NYSE owner announces tradexyz perps on Hyperliquid will be [offered to retail](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2115770168026841306?a=9gqBWPbOFv8HQJzjjmE&s=20) through partnership with OKX — Stan Druckenmiller lays out his plans to [trade perps on Hyperliquid](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2115779536696570286?a=sS3Tg3fsRNJfkjxFabs&s=20)

* [KNTQ](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/kinetiq/) prints new ATH and [HYPE](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/hyperliquid/) surges 10%

* Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says Treasury will close [SEC-CFTC](https://www.chooserich.live/story/scott-bessent-crypto-dollar-dominance-mw9sk36) crypto gaps with or without Congress

* Alphabet shares fall over [7%](https://x.com/bespokeinvest/status/2115535285446377799) after Q3 revenue of $127.58B misses expectations

* Google unveils [Gemini 4 Carbon](https://www.chooserich.live/story/google-unveils-gemini-4-carbon-ta9bjeu), Pichai says it ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index

* Claude launches gallery of ready-made [artifacts for legal work](https://x.com/claudeai/status/2115467192276025500)

* GitHub Copilot Fusion delivers[ frontier-level coding](https://x.com/satyanadella/status/2115577765995123084) quality at up to 77% lower cost

* DOJ inquires about Nvidia's [$12.93B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/doj-scrutinizes-nvidia-hugging-face-vzgjtpe) purchase of Hugging Face, sources say

* Microsoft tops estimates with EPS of $4.89 and revenue of [$92.3B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/microsoft-beats-quarterly-earnings-expectations-jq4yfpt) — Microsoft stock jumps over [5%](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2115535320678555980)

* Hyperliquid burns nearly [$4B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/hyperliquid-burns-hype-token-supply-tsh378i) in HYPE tokens, cutting supply by almost 5%

* CFTC chair Selig says [autonomous AI agents](https://www.chooserich.live/story/cftc-selig-autonomous-ai-trading-38jex9g) could trade crypto, requiring new regulations

* Visa says stablecoin settlement volume tops [$25B](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2115607403882582372) annualized, up 10x year over year

* Hacker publishes personal data of more than [40,000](https://www.chooserich.live/story/homeland-security-data-leak-7jz7ax6) Homeland Security staffers
